officialCorroboration.finding: BFT51U format changed effective 2019-07-29; record length 80 bytes and price-field formats are documented, but the indexed announcement does not state the issued/listed raw units.
Another daily product separately exposes 發行張數 and 上市股數, useful for semantic/date reconciliation but not sufficient to prove BFT51U raw numeric units.

Daily from 2020-03-02; exposes both 交易單位 and 發行股數. This is a promising independent post-2020 denominator/trading-unit reconciliation lane, but the indexed product page does not itself state the raw numeric unit of 發行股數.
Daily from 2020-03-02 and explicitly includes 交易單位 per security. This can identify non-standard trading units for denominator normalization.

officialCorroboration.source: TWSE T32 non-thousand trading-unit securities file
officialCorroboration.finding: Official daily file explicitly exists for foreign-currency and non-thousand-share/unit securities. Therefore a universal x1000 transform based only on the word 張 is unsafe unless security scope and source format are proven.

A separate official product explicitly labels issued shares as 發行股數 (單位：仟股), proving that TWSE does state units when intended. BFT51U indexed product text does not expose the same explicit unit statement.

officialCorroboration.source: TWSE listed common-share/TDR share-count change announcement (LT185)
officialCorroboration.finding: Official TWSE public surface provides announcement date and effective date for listed common-share/TDR unit-count changes and CSV download. TWSE's own filing-operation material explicitly labels 已上市股數/申報上市股數/累計 in 股 and states cumulative listed shares exclude private-placement and restricted-trading shares in the illustrated workflow. This is explicit share-unit evidence for the event-driven listed-share-change lane, but it is not itself a complete daily denominator snapshot.

candidateInterpretations.reason: Taiwan lot terminology and other TWSE materials associate 張 with thousand shares in ordinary contexts, but BFT51U exact format/sample unit proof is still unavailable and official non-thousand trading-unit securities exist.

positiveNegativeConclusion.positive: Daily TWSE issued/listed denominator products and daily trading-unit reference products are officially documented, so a correct archive is structurally feasible. TWSE LT185 additionally provides an official event-driven listed-share-change lane with explicit share-count/effective-date semantics.
positiveNegativeConclusion.negative: The exact BFT51U raw-unit conversion is still not proven in the accessible official text surfaces, and non-thousand-unit securities invalidate a blind universal x1000 assumption. LT185 is not a complete daily denominator snapshot, so it cannot by itself replace unresolved BFT51U/BFI85U raw-unit proof.

antiInference: Do not treat field-name translation as unit proof.
Do not use current snapshots to backfill historical denominators.
